def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    for i, (r, c, v) in enumerate(pts):
        for rr, cc, vv in pts[i + 1:]:
            if vv != v or rr == r or abs(rr-r) != abs(cc-c):
                continue
            dr = 1 if rr > r else -1
            dc = 1 if cc > c else -1
            y, x = rr + dr, cc + dc
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w and out[y][x] != bg:
                dr, dc = -dr, -dc
                y, x = r + dr, c + dc
            while 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w and out[y][x] == bg:
                out[y][x] = v
                y += dr
                x += dc
    return out
